newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Jurys says 1996 trading ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: Jurys says 1996 trading ahead of last year.

text.p: Irish hotel chain Jurys Hotel Group Plc said on Monday that trading levels for the first two months of the current fiscal year were well ahead of last year.

"Almost four months into the year, the strong pattern of trading has been sustained and I look forward to another very successful year for your company," chairman Walter Beatty said in a statement at the group's annual shareholders meeting.
He said Jurys had gained from its exposure to the strong Irish economy through its corporate and commercial business, tourism, event-related activity and weekend business breaks.
"Economic fundamentals remain positive and we are confident that your group will continue to benefit from this environment," Beatty said.
He told shareholders that Jurys was currently in discussions with a developer to establish a 150 room Jurys Inn in Limerick in the west of Ireland.
"The proposed location is a superb city centre site on the banks of the River Shannon," Beatty said, adding that the company will make a full announcement if the discussions prove successful.
